### Overview
Yes, cosmetic surgeries for treating gender dysphoria are covered under Medicaid in Colorado (known as Health First Colorado), provided they are deemed medically necessary and align with established standards of care, such as those from the World Professional Association for Transgender Health (WPATH). Procedures often classified as "cosmetic" in other contexts—such as facial feminization surgery (e.g., facial bone remodeling), chest reconstruction (e.g., mastectomy or breast augmentation), hair removal, and tracheal shave—are explicitly included when they address gender dysphoria. Coverage is not blanket approval for all procedures but requires meeting specific criteria, including a clinical diagnosis.
